items.q: Are electronic signatures valid in Puerto Rico?
items.a: Yes. Puerto Rico's Electronic Transactions Act (Law 148-2006) and the federal ESIGN Act recognize electronic records and signatures. ContractOS records the date, time, IP address and device of every signature.

items.q: Does the lease replace a lawyer?
items.a: No. ContractOS gives you a solid template and tools to manage it, but it doesn't give legal advice. For specific situations, consult an attorney.

items.q: Does my tenant need an account?
items.a: They can review and sign from the link you send. If they want to see their leases later, they can create a free account.
